summary: Strong chunky construction and distinguishable head silhouettes, with a promising Administrator. However, several everyday kits read as contemporary outdoor clothing or medieval dress with gadgets, rather than unmistakably Future. Attachment and underlying-clothing cleanup are also needed.
problems: Seed-Capsule Gardener reads primarily as a sun hat, utility vest, trousers and boots. The capsules and wrist device do not outweigh the contemporary gardening silhouette.
Canopy Apprentice reads as a backwards baseball cap, padded vest, shorts and knee socks. Backpack attachments alone do not establish the age.

Habitat Memory Weaver reads as a hooded robed craftsperson holding a miniature loom. Its thin cyan threads disappear at stream scale, and the frame lacks a clearly visible connection to the hand or cuff.

Courier has the strongest everyday futuristic construction, but its central helmet crest and rectangular purple tabard also suggest a robot knight. Courier, Weaver and Envoy repeat similar purple frontal panels and blue-grey bodies.

Administrator has useful grandeur, a distinctive three-screen crown and a recognisable constellation badge. The narrow crown supports need clearer structural continuity, and the front-only office emblem loses prominence from above.

Envoy resembles a patched version of the local Courier more than an android delegation from elsewhere. The gold spear-like staff tip reinforces a medieval traveller reading; its small orbital badge cannot carry the foreign identity alone.

Pink shoulder strips and avatar-dependent wrist and shoe-edge details interrupt the intended materials. Several kits leave default sleeves visible. These inconsistencies are particularly apparent between the two wearers of each kit.
fix: Seed-Capsule Gardener: Replace the conventional brim-and-crown hat with a low, segmented grow-light canopy, visibly bracketed to a rear collar. Replace the tan vest halves with an asymmetric sealed cultivation bib. Raise the two seed capsules enough to read beside the head from above, retaining the broad sage silhouette. Hide default sleeves and fully enclose the original footwear. Ceramic Wrap-Tabard Courier: Keep the white shell, dark joints and parcel. Replace the knight-like central crest with an offset horizontal sensor block; reshape the purple rectangle into stepped, overlapping ceramic wrap plates. Give the parcel one broad cyan top panel rather than relying on its narrow front stripe. Habitat Memory Weaver: Turn the hood into an open-sided asymmetric data cowl with a large contrasting inset. Break the robe-like mass into overlapping torso panels and separate leg-mounted panels, preserving a visible leg gap. Add a solid grip or short bracket from the cuff to the loom; replace the three hairline threads with one bold cyan membrane inside a thicker frame. Hide remaining default sleeves. Canopy Apprentice: Remove the baseball cap and shorts-and-socks construction. Use a close-fitting ceramic brow band and a full-length articulated work suit with distinct knee joints. Consolidate the backpack clutter into one large folded canopy fin with a visible hinge, keeping this silhouette narrow and asymmetric rather than broad like the Gardener. Hide default sleeves and cover shoe edges. Administrator of the Shared Constellation: Preserve the white mantle, dark centre and three-screen crown. Connect every screen with substantial visible struts to one rigid upper-back assembly, parenting the supports and screens consistently. Repeat an enlarged, simplified constellation mark on the upward-facing mantle or crown top. Check the rear mantle against both legs throughout walking. Far-Orbit Patched-Tabard Envoy: Establish a separate charcoal-and-amber material language, a nonhuman face display and exposed mechanical neck blocks. Add a compact angular orbital frame physically mounted behind the head, distinct from both the Courier crest and Administrator crown. Replace the gold spearhead with a broad forked communications terminal; enlarge and repeat the orbital insignia on an upper-facing shoulder plate. Keep the patched asymmetry, but make it repaired machine casing rather than mismatched cloth. For every kit, verify both body variants at the actual stream camera and during walking, with no hovering accessories, exposed default garments or panels bridging moving limbs.
